judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the room layout, left bunk beds, central wooden cabinet, fireplace and exposed wall framing. Framing and scale differ substantially: the right foreground bunk occupies much more of the image, the cabinet appears smaller, and the fireplace is narrower with its broad stone surround missing. The ceiling beam arrangement differs, and the reference’s peeling ceiling finish is absent. Bedding is flatter and less detailed; the radiator, hearth accessories and cabinet contents are missing or indistinct. The floor is pale and uniformly striped rather than dark, worn, broad wooden planks. Walls and timber have simpler, lighter finishes, while the render is visibly grainy. Bed feet appear to meet the floor, but contact shadows and the fireplace’s floor boundary are less distinct than in the reference.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The larger right bunk and smaller rear furnishings may reflect differences in camera position, field of view, object scale or spacing; the images do not distinguish these causes. The fireplace appears shallower and the rear bunks more compressed, but these are projection-based impressions, not verified depth differences. Visible floor contacts do not establish hidden support or geometry correctness.
